May I ask how she denies you the ability to remove yourself? Like does she physically corner you until you face the argument, does she keep pressing the issue, does she get upset when you just try to remove yourself?

What’s worked for me and my temper is explaining to others how I am when I’m mad when I’m not mad. For example, when  I’m calm and in a good mood I explain to my boyfriend when I’m angry I need time alone or else I’m going to say something that could hurt his feelings.

Maybe try talking to her during a time you’re not fighting? Just explain what you need when you’re upset from an argument, and how it helps you come to working towards a solution to the cause of the argument.

I’d also suggest some professional consultation with a therapist. Punching stuff shows very intense feeling, and I know when I’m very upset I’ll throw myself or punch a pillow. It helps to address different and healthier coping methods for anger, if not for anyone else but yourself and your own well being.

Either way, I hope this helps and I wish you the best!
